resolution.note: shard-wall-report --since <sha> keeps main runs whose head is the commit or descends from it (git merge-base --is-ancestor injected into a pure runsSince, tested); prints 'runs: N of M wanted since <sha>'; unknown sha exits 64

title: Shard wall report: --since <sha> window
body:
Outcome: the shard wall report measures only runs after a given commit, so acceptance windows exclude runs from an older shard plan.
Evidence: t-mgj0693 acceptance (p50 over 5 main runs) mixed 8-shard runs with the 10-shard plan of #356 (2194438).
Acceptance: node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since <sha> keeps only main runs whose head descends from <sha> (git merge-base --is-ancestor), with a test.
